courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Airbus A320 飛控架構
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「航跡時間戳與資料年齡」推進到「重要狀態的視覺辨識」，最後以「失聯與重連情境交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Track timestamps and data age through Visual recognition of critical status to Link-loss and reconnection scenario handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 民用無人機地面站介面
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「航跡時間戳與資料年齡」推進到「重要狀態的視覺辨識」，最後以「失聯與重連情境交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Track timestamps and data age through Visual recognition of critical status to Link-loss and reconnection scenario handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「讓地面站明確顯示資料年齡、模式與不確定度」為主線，在非飛行地面站互動原型中依序完成航跡時間戳與資料年齡、事件到地面顯示時間、重要狀態的視覺辨識、告警排序與誤警、地圖和感測來源差異及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Make ground stations show data age, mode and uncertainty explicitly in a Non-flying interactive ground-station prototype, progressing through Track timestamps and data age, Event-to-ground-display time, Visual recognition of critical status, Alert ordering and false positives, Differences between map and sensor sources, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
